decision.observation: The '!' button tooltip just reads 'A unit needs orders.' This is the 'select next unit needing orders' button, not end-turn. The Eagle Warrior indicates with a small blue icon above the city banner (~0.49,0.31). Selecting it works but moves fail.
decision.hypothesis: In Civ VI, when a unit is selected, clicking a destination tile moves it. Our clicks deselect, meaning maybe the click needs to be ON a hex further along a valid path and the unit IS moving but returns? Or the game only registers movement via holding. Actually, maybe the problem: I should click the '!' to select unit, THEN double-click a far tile. But adjacent should work. Since the unit is in the city (garrisoned), clicking the city tile area toggles. The actual unit icon is at the top of the city banner. Let me select the unit via '!' then drag it to an adjacent tile (drag = move).
decision.memory: Use '!' to select, then DRAG unit to adjacent tile.
